title: Photo 189 · 콜로설 · 팔레흐 · 걸터앉기 3/4 · 라틴 20대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth deep-charcoal wall behind her, nothing in the frame but a single backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Latina woman in her late 20s, warm golden-tan skin tone with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a braided crown wrapped around her head, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears long tassel earrings and has glossy ballerina-shaped nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that it overflows the stone bench on both sides and is cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A giantess built on a completely even scale, every part of her enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs and thick heavy calves, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body, her shoulders span more than four head-widths, each hand is as wide as a normal woman's torso and each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging folds, not pregnant, her whole body scaled up together into one immense smooth silhouette that towers over the viewer. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is young and firm for its size, each fold holding a taut rounded shape. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it settles, spreads and presses down against the hard stone beneath her.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Russian Palekh miniature style — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and small jewel-toned scenes of firebirds, horses and winter forests in crimson, emerald and ultramarine, a gold border band following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, gold filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Seated on the backless stone bench with her hips turned about 45 degrees away from the camera so the great curve of her rear and one hip spreading out on the stone is seen from the side, her torso twisted back toward the lens and her face turned to the camera, the great mass of her middle settling forward over her thighs seen at an angle, her near knee toward the camera and her far leg angled away, one hand resting back on the bench behind her hip and the other resting on her near thigh, both arms held clear of her body so nothing crosses in front of her torso, her feet flat on the floor, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge of the bench presses into them, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme gold T-strap platform stiletto sandals, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the gold filigree glinting, the black ground reading clearly as paint on skin rather than as fabric, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
